content.title: Persistent Selector Variant | Cursor-Synchronized Product World Swaps
content.summary: Establish one persistent interface, one visible pointer and one default subject state. Allow one pointer selection at a time and change all declared state channels together. Keep layout, control positions and subject identity registered through every swap. Vary palette, material, environment accent and concise label without adding uncontrolled channels. Return to the complete interface and hold one clearly selected final state.

quick_start.input_format: Establish one persistent interface, one visible pointer and one default subject state. + Allow one pointer selection at a time and change all declared state channels together. + Keep layout, control positions and subject identity registered through every swap. + Vary palette, material, environment accent and concise label without adding uncontrolled channels. + Return to the complete interface and hold one clearly selected final state.
quick_start.recommended_input: Show an original desktop configurator for one modular desk lamp; establish a fixed left option rail, central lamp viewport, right material note and one visible pointer. Hover 'PAPER' then 'METAL'; change shade material, ambient color and one background motif together while the lamp base, camera and interface grid remain fixed. Pull back to the complete four-option interface, keep 'STONE' visibly selected and hold the unchanged lamp in its final state.

usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: Establish one persistent interface, one visible pointer and one default subject state. Allow one pointer selection at a time and change all declared state channels together. Keep layout, control positions and subject identity registered through every swap. Vary palette, material, environment accent and concise label without adding uncontrolled channels. Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: Establish one persistent interface, one visible pointer and one default subject state. Allow one pointer selection at a time and change all declared state channels together. Keep layout, control positions and subject identity registered through every swap. Vary palette, material, environment accent and concise label without adding uncontrolled channels. Return to the complete interface and hold one clearly selected final state. The reusable mechanism is the ordered baseline, trigger, continuity, controlled escalation and terminal proof—not the source identities, brands, wording, locations, props, exact styling, choreography, camera path, creator identity or timing.

invariants.rule: Establish one persistent interface, one visible pointer and one default subject state.
invariants.purpose: Makes the baseline measurable before the mechanism changes it.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without the baseline, later change has no trustworthy reference state.

invariants.rule: Allow one pointer selection at a time and change all declared state channels together.
invariants.purpose: Binds the first visible change to a specific cause rather than decoration.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without a visible trigger, the transition reads as an arbitrary edit.

invariants.rule: Keep layout, control positions and subject identity registered through every swap.
invariants.purpose: Preserves identity, material or spatial continuity through the middle transition.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without continuity, the sequence becomes unrelated montage or identity drift.

invariants.rule: Vary palette, material, environment accent and concise label without adding uncontrolled channels.
invariants.purpose: Raises intensity or information while retaining the same readable grammar.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without controlled escalation, the middle either plateaus or turns into noise.

invariants.rule: Return to the complete interface and hold one clearly selected final state.
invariants.purpose: Provides a terminal proof that resolves the mechanism instead of merely stopping.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without terminal proof, the promised result or reversal remains unverified.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: source ice-cream cones, flavors, toppings and food styling
source website layout, thumbnail positions and cursor path
source flavor names, logo, product labels and typography
source exact palettes, transitions, camera crop and timing
source creator identity, MiniMax H3 claim, platform marks and thread prompt wording
